context: A barista finalizes a B2B coffee supply for a corporate office
purpose: Teach: 放出/談合/次長/書房/三菱/東芝/ブロガー/ベイ

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: ご提案資料、お持ちしました。御社の三菱系列のオフィス向けプランです。
lines.en: I've brought the proposal materials for you — this is the plan designed for your Mitsubishi-group offices.
lines.style: Warm but businesslike. Controlled pace. Opens clearly on 'brought,' landing the detail with quiet confidence. Professional posture.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ありがとうございます。次長の決裁も近いので、ベイ地区の店舗対応も伺えますか。
lines.en: Thank you. The deputy director's approval is coming up soon, so could we go over the Bay-area store support plan as well?
lines.style: Measured, thoughtful. Slight lift on the request — not demanding, inviting partnership. Leans forward slightly in tone. Businesslike but genuine.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: はい。在庫放出のサイクル、東芝向けと共通化できる予定です。
lines.en: Yes. We can sync the inventory release cycle with what we're doing for Toshiba.
lines.style: Clear and direct. Confidence without swagger. Even pacing. Brief, because the answer is straightforward — no hedging needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 広報誌、岩波書房のグループ会報にも掲載予定ですので、写真を一枚お願いできますか。
lines.en: The piece will also run in our Iwanami Bookhouse group newsletter, so would you be able to provide a photo?
lines.style: Gentle, specific ask. Warm but formal. Ends on a slight upturn — opening space for yes. Not tentative, just genuinely courteous.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: もちろんです。社内ブロガー向けにも素材を共有しておきます。
lines.en: Of course. I'll share materials with your internal bloggers too.
lines.style: Immediate warmth on 'of course.' Relaxed, no hesitation. Collaborative ease — this is what partners do. Slight brightness in the voice.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 助かります。業界の談合報道後、信頼回復が課題ですので、ありがたいです。
lines.en: That really helps. Trust-building is crucial for us after all the industry news, so I appreciate it.
lines.style: Honest exhale. The professional mask down slightly — not vulnerable, just real. Quieter, more direct. Gratitude without performance.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: こちらこそ、長いお付き合いになるよう精一杯やらせていただきます。
lines.en: I want this to grow into a long partnership too. I'll give it everything I've got.
lines.style: Warm, present. No overdoing it. Steady eye-level commitment. The closing is sincere without being sentimental. Calm conviction.
